subject: Post-demo recap: procurement path, billing expectations, and next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@auroraht.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo recap: procurement path, billing expectations, and next steps

Hi Lydia — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can align with your procurement and billing teams: 

1) Procurement path: From our conversation it sounded like Aurora prefers to use a formal PO + net-30 payment for platform subscriptions, but you also mentioned the marketplace could be an option for smaller pilot projects. Can you confirm which route (PO vs marketplace) is the preferred path for the initial pilot? If PO, who on your side will raise it?

2) Billing details we need to finalize: preferred billing address, legal entity to invoice, VAT handling for EU customers (exempt vs reverse charge), and whether you require a line-item invoice vs a consolidated monthly invoice.

3) Commercials and net terms: We proposed net-30 for the pilot in the quote; is that acceptable or does finance require net-45/net-60 or credit vetting?

4) Attachments: attaching the draft SOW and the quote we ran through on the call for visibility. If helpful, we can produce a version formatted specifically for a PO (with purchase order line items).

Next steps proposed: if you can confirm procurement route + point of contact, we’ll prepare a PO-ready invoice template and a DocuSign SOW for signature. Happy to loop in Finance if you want a quick sync.

Best,
Jonas
Sales Lead, EMEA
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Aurora_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: Redwood_Quote_4821.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@auroraht.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@auroraht.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:35:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: procurement path, billing expectations, and next steps

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear notes and the docs. Quick answers from procurement/ops: 

- For the pilot (3 months, limited scope) we usually prefer to transact via the cloud marketplace for speed (card or market invoicing). For anything >€10k or longer-term we insist on a PO + net-30.
- For this engagement we are leaning toward marketplace to avoid a lengthy PO cycle, but we need finance approval on spend.
- VAT: Aurora is registered in Germany; we expect reverse-charge to apply for B2B EU services. We will need your VAT ID on the invoice; if Redwood is outside the EU, our tax team will provide a reverse-charge template.
- Billing address / legal entity: Aurora HealthTech GmbH, Grafenstrasse 8, 80331 München — please use the GmbH entity for the invoice.

I’ll confirm whether we can use card for the marketplace purchase (I’ll try to get internal approval today). If not, we’ll need to raise a PO and loop in our vendor onboarding (Marco, can you confirm vendor setup timeline?).

Lydia
Procurement Manager
Aurora HealthTech

Jonas / Lydia — looping in here from vendor onboarding / finance at Aurora. A couple of practical notes that will speed things up on our side: 

- If you can provide a PO-ready invoice template (CSV or PDF with line items, tax fields and Redwood VAT ID), we can pre-populate our vendor system and accelerate PO creation if marketplace is not available.
- Our vendor team requires the following files for EU vendors: supplier W-9 equivalent (we provided tax form template), company registry excerpt, and a signed SOW. A scanned SOW + quote is fine to start vendor creation.
- Net terms: finance prefers net-30; net-45 only in exceptional cases. Credit checks typically take 2–3 business days.

Marissa — can Redwood share a marketplace SKU for a 3-month pilot and a PO-ready invoice template? Also please confirm Redwood’s VAT ID so our tax team can validate reverse-charge.

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Aurora HealthTech

Billing entity for Aurora pilot: Redwood Inference Inc., 140 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. For EU VAT reverse-charge we typically omit VAT on the invoice and include our VAT ID plus the statement: 'Reverse charge applies under Article 194 of the VAT Directive.'
